description:
Roberts are delighted to offer for sale this superb and characterful three-bedroom mid-terrace home, tucked away within a quiet cul-de-sac yet exceptionally well positioned for Bournemouth amenities.

The property is just a few minutes' walk from Bournemouth's main railway and bus stations, making it particularly convenient for commuters. A good selection of local shops, supermarkets and everyday amenities are also within easy reach. Bournemouth town centre, leisure facilities and award-winning beaches are just a short bus journey away.

The accommodation offers an excellent combination of period character and practical living space with two separate reception rooms. The lounge features a working open fireplace whilst the separate dining room enjoys views over the rear courtyard garden. To the rear is the dual-aspect kitchen, which has been presented with an appealing country-style, rustic character and benefits from fitted appliances. A door provides direct access to the private rear courtyard garden.

Upstairs, the property offers three double bedrooms. The landing benefits from a useful range of fitted storage cupboards, while the modern family bathroom is fitted with a white suite complemented by traditional-style tiling.

The boarded attic provides valuable additional storage and may also offer potential for a loft conversion, as seen in some neighbouring properties, subject to the necessary planning permissions and building regulations.

To the rear is a private, low-maintenance courtyard garden enjoying a south-easterly aspect offering a pleasant and manageable outside space.

Further benefits include gas central heating via a combination boiler, UPVC double glazing and a number of retained period features, giving the property an appealing balance between traditional character and modern-day convenience.

Offered for sale chain free. For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact the sole selling agents, Roberts.
